messages:
Ashley: Heads up — started a cross-account KMS rotation this morning and we just started seeing provisioning backpressure in eu-west-1 GPU pools. VPC peering alarms popped too. Anyone on infra?
Ben: saw the spike, autoscaler stuck with a bunch of Pending pods and API 504s to the provisioning service. Logs show KMS/STS failures.
Caroline: quick check: I see AssumeRole errors from the provisioner when talking to account:infra-secrets. Error: "AccessDenied: not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole on resource arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/ProvisionerCrossAccountRole"
Ashley: yep — we tightened the trust policy when rotating to require an externalId to mitigate replay. Forgot to update the provisioner config to set ext_id. My bad.
Dmitri: that explains it. Provisioner retries are saturating the control-plane connections; the autoscaler can't reconcile. We should stop the rotation or patch the provisioner ASAP.
Ashley: patch ready — sets external_id env var and retries with exponential backoff. Pushing a canary to eu-west-1 now.
infra-bot: Alert: vpc-peering-eu-west-1 latency > 200ms (5m avg). Triggered routing fallback.
sre-oncall: also seeing increased NAT gateway egress and KMS API quota near 90%. If provisioner retries backoff not applied this could hit KMS throttling.
Ben: we should throttle provisioner retry loop immediately. Can we flip a feature flag?
Caroline: yes, there's a runtime flag FLAG_PROVISIONER_STRICT_RETRY. Setting to true will reduce attempts to 3 and add 10s base backoff. Applying now.
Ashley: changed config, restarted 2 provisioner replicas in eu-west-1 canary pool. Monitoring logs.
Dmitri: good. Also recommend a temporary policy change: allow sts:AssumeRole without externalId from the provisioner role while we complete rotation, then revert in 24h. That will quickly unblock capacity.
Caroline: ops on that: if we relax the trust policy we need an audit entry and approval from sec. Can we do a scoped exception limited to the provisioner principal?
Ashley: filing a scoped exception in the security queue now and pinging @sec-team. Link: https://internal.redwood/sec-requests/CR-4721
infra-bot: DeployBot: canary restart succeeded for provisioner-eu-west-1-2 (build 2026.03.17-ff2).
sre-oncall: after the flag flip, KMS 400s drop by ~70% and pending pods reduce. Cluster CPU for control-plane still high, but trending down.
Ben: cost note — because retries were large we consumed ~6k extra KMS requests in 30m; may bump next invoice. Logging a cost incident under finance ops.
Caroline: aftersec approved scoped exception for 3h window while rotation finishes, sec asked for an audit log and rollback playbook. I'll attach audit commands below.
Caroline: Audit commands: ```bash
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /aws/kms/requests --filter-pattern "AssumeRole" --start-time 1679060000000
aws iam get-role --role-name ProvisionerCrossAccountRole
```
Ashley: will run those and paste results to the ticket. Planning: 1) keep retry flag, 2) finish rotation with ext_id applied to provisioner configs, 3) revert trust policy immediately after. Expect full capacity back in ~20-30m.
Dmitri: agree. Also add a circuit breaker in provisioner to fail fast if KMS rate limit > 80% for >2 min to avoid control-plane saturation. Filing a backlog ticket: INFRA-912.
Ben: thanks everyone. I'll keep an eye on GPU pool healthy counts and post an update in 10m. :thumbsup:
Ashley: update in 9m — canaries look good, pending queue down from 42 -> 6, KMS errors near zero. Will coordinate rollback plan.
infra-bot: Incident note: temporary security exception recorded CR-4721, expires in 3h.
Caroline: leaving reminders: add runbook step to update external_id whenever rotating cross-account keys, and add a pre-rotation checklist item to confirm consumers set ext_id.
Ashley: noted. Closing loop after rotation finishes. Thanks all.
